notes.title: A new chapter release - November 01!
notes.content:
Hurray! 

A [b]new chapter [/b]of Plot of the Druid will be released on [b]01.11[/b].  So save the date!
The game will be released in 'chapter-by-chapter' format, so it will appear in Steam as Early Access. 
This moment deserved as NEW cover, don't you think? ;-)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39773811/7e19a2f74c82e73ce664d9a7e9876df95add758a.png[/img]

[b]Why Early Access?[/b]
The new chapter will be followed with another 3 chapters as soon as they are ready. 
Since it can take time, I think it's good to give you a ready-to-play chapter. 
And for me - getting feedback during the dev, and more funding help going with.

[previewyoutube=Dw5JdC7Bnhw;full][/previewyoutube]

In the meantime, please [b]wishlist the full game and share with friends[/b] as much as you can, every wishlist counts!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1108170/

Cheers,
Yakir

notes.title: Talkie version - deadline
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Today is the [b]last day[/b] to reach the [b]talkie version[/b] stretch goal for Plot of the Druid ⏰
If we won't reach it, the full game will be release with [b]text only[/b].

Late backers will also be able to vote for an animal for Jase to shapeshift into! 🐻🐰🐨🐒

Support here => https://plotofthedruid.com
Every support counts 🤞
